name: work_mem
description: Maximum memory available for each internal sort operation and hash table before spilling to temporary disk files.
symptoms: High IO wait due to excessive temp file usage
OOM error from over-allocation across concurrent operations
Slow sorting or hashing on large datasets
Excessive temporary file creation and disk I/O
Memory pressure leading to OS-level swapping
tuning_tips: Set per-workspace memory based on query complexity and concurrency: lower (1–4 MB) for OLTP with high connection count; higher (64–1024 MB) for OLAP with few concurrent heavy queries. Monitor temp file generation and memory usage to validate.
